# Exact R03b method bodies for offline regression only. NOT a journal.
def add_parameters(self,part,params):
        self.ensure_work(part)
        created=set();visiting=set()
        def add(name):
            if name in created:return
            if name in visiting:raise ValueError('Zyklische Parameter vor NX-Expression: '+name)
            visiting.add(name)
            item=params.items[name]
            if item.get('unit') not in ('mm','deg'):raise ValueError('Nicht unterstuetzte Einheit: '+name)
            if item.get('value') is None and item.get('formula') is None:
                visiting.remove(name)
                return
            rhs=item.get('formula')
            if rhs is not None:
                for dep in sorted(params.dependencies(rhs)):add(dep)
            else:rhs=format(params.value(name),'.12g')
            params.value(name)  # Endlichkeit/Abhaengigkeiten vor NX pruefen.
            unit_name='Degrees' if item['unit']=='deg' else 'MilliMeter'
            unit=part.UnitCollection.FindObject(unit_name)
            expression=part.Expressions.CreateWithUnits(name+'='+str(rhs),unit)
            self.attributes(expression,{'id':name,'status':item['status'],'sources':item.get('sources',[])})
            created.add(name);visiting.remove(name)
        for name in params.items:add(name)
        return len(created)

def attributes(self,obj,meta):
        sources='; '.join('%s S.%s %s'%(s.get('document','?'),s.get('page','?'),s.get('location','')) for s in meta.get('sources',[]))
        values={'HAUS_ID':meta.get('id',''), 'QUELLSTATUS':meta.get('status',''),
                'BAUZUSTAND':meta.get('phase','UNGEKLAERT'), 'QUELLE':sources,
                'MODELLART':'NX_GEOMETRIE_KEIN_NATIVES_BIM', 'GENAUIGKEIT':'PRUEFMODELL_NICHT_AUSFUEHRUNGSREIF', 'REVISION':'R03',
                'ELTERN_ID':meta.get('parent_id',''), 'WIRTSWAND':meta.get('host_wall',''),
                'KATEGORIE':meta.get('category',meta.get('kind','')), 'MATERIAL':meta.get('material',''),
                'DETAILHERKUNFT':meta.get('detail_origin','PLANREKONSTRUKTION_MIT_NAEHERUNGEN')}
        for key,value in values.items():
            obj.SetUserAttribute(key,-1,str(value),self.N.Update.Option.Now)
